correctness.rationale: The exact graph and complex are defined. Two independent complete face enumerations agree on 1,222,549 nonempty simplices. All 611,209 Morse pairs and 8,827,379 directed Hasse incidences are reconstructed and their acyclicity globally checked. Signed gradient-path recurrence gives an integral 112-by-18 Morse boundary; 18 explicit unit eliminations show no nonunit invariant. Hurewicz and homotopy cell cancellations imply a wedge of 94 seven-spheres. All computations are rerun by the included standalone source.

value.rationale: A natural width-eight case of a newly studied three-row family gains a complete integral homotopy type after withdrawal of a general all-width wedge claim. The exact acyclic matching and primitive integral Morse differential establish the sphere-wedge structure and a reproducible test for future general constructions; neither simple connectivity nor Betti numbers alone supplies this information.
